properties.name: A seat is told the shared record moved when it ORIENTS rather than when it writes — Anthony's option A. The signal existed and was read in exactly one place; this reads it at the first moment instead of the last. Carries a real defect fix found while building it: the stale-seat guard trusted the content hash a file states about ITSELF, so a merged or hand-edited record read as untouched and its work could be silently overwritten on the next export.
